# GrindInfo

> GrindInfo is an esports community platform for discovering scrims, connecting with players, and following tournament and community activity.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.grindinfo.xyz/): Explore the GrindInfo community platform.
- [Scrims](https://www.grindinfo.xyz/tournaments): Browse and host community scrims.
- [Games](https://www.grindinfo.xyz/games): Browse supported games and their community pages.
- [Find players](https://www.grindinfo.xyz/find-players): Find players after signing in.
- [Community blog](https://www.grindinfo.xyz/blog): Read community posts.

GrindInfo is an independent community platform and is not an official representative of game publishers or tournament organizers.
